integrity: The general theorem is proved by an exact orbit-barycenter model and a strong-collapse argument. Finite computation is corroborative only; relevant nonequivariant homotopy is cited as prior work, not new.
scientific_limitations: Only the simultaneous paired shore-exchange involution of balanced complete bipartite generalized Mycielskians is classified. Quotient homology is rational; integral torsion and general automorphism-fixed spaces are not determined.
title: Shore-exchange fixed spaces of generalized Mycielski independence complexes
